definitions.explanation: The act of switching from one vehicle or transportation line to another during a journey.
Changing from one thing to another (e.g., products, services, plans).

examples.japanese: {新宿|しんじゅく}で{乗換|のりかえ}が{必要|ひつよう}です。
examples.english: You need to transfer at Shinjuku.

examples.japanese: {乗換|のりかえ}{案内|あんない}を{確認|かくにん}してください。
{携帯|けいたい}を{別|べつ}の{会社|かいしゃ}に{乗換|のりかえ}ました。
examples.english: I switched my mobile phone to a different carrier.

notes:
USAGE: {乗換|のりかえ} (also written as {乗|の}り{換|か}え) is essential vocabulary for navigating Japanese public transportation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Xで{乗換|のりかえ}る (to transfer at X)
- {乗換|のりかえ}なし (no transfer required, direct)
- {乗換|のりかえ}{時間|じかん} (transfer time)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {乗換|のりかえ}{駅|えき} (transfer station)
- {乗換|のりかえ}{案内|あんない} (transfer guide)
- {乗換|のりかえ}{検索|けんさく} (route search)

RELATED VERB:
- {乗|の}り{換|か}える (to transfer) - godan verb
